title: Workaround for android 10 BT issues
body:
Found workaround for android 10 connection issues. Still getting wierd error msg every reading in the log BUT , managed to solv the reconnecting issues when it looses connection and cant connect back. Problem seems to be the bluetooth getting stuck in scanning mode since it cant close bt connection properly for some reason in android 10.. Tick this box and it should work for now.. It's not ideal and draws some more battery but only thing i found working fiddling in xdtrip

Are there any news? Got the same problem with my xiaomi mi 9 on android 10; now with Huawei P30Pro on Android 9 and dont wanna update to Android 10 because of this problem

Yes, there is what appears to be a solution for Dexcom/G6 BT connectivity problems to several different Android-10 devices.  Nightly & Beta releases after 22-December seem to have solved the problem for me & several others.  See Issue https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1061# for details.
@edisiENt okay, thank you! Can anyone confirm running xdrip+, Dexcom G6 (with 8G.. transmitter) on Huawei P30 Pro / Android 10?

@Ferdinandoz I am having a Mate 20 Pro with (now) Android 10 / EMUI 10. Immediately after the Upgrade to Android 10 the [DexcomAPP2.4](https://github.com/dexcomapp/dexcomapp/tree/master/2.4) basically stopped working. So I tried xDrip-plus nightly and it didn't work either. To make it work I had to do exactly as written [here](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1061#issuecomment-573432564).
Additionally, I had to **check** the "Authenticate G5 before each read" and "scan for G5 Constantly".
@Pamalosebi Thanks for your advice, I will have a look at the other thread!

Hey @Ferdinandoz ,
I had to rollback to Android 9. With those settings above it might work on Android 10. But all in all it's way too unstable. It is also dangerous if you don't have valid measurements for over 6 hours at nights.
I guess it is some problem with the Bluetooth stack in Android 10. I had authorization errors before every single read of the Dexcom G6 in Android 10. While there are none errors within Android 9 procedures.

@Pamalosebi Okay, thank you very much for telling this right before my update 👍 I  remember such problems from back then when I owned a Xiaomi Mi 9 and updated to Android 10. Thats the reason for my concerns. I think I'll wait, can't have something like this right now. 😄

Samsung S10, Android 10.

It works. My proposal for those, who have the connection issue: use night build 24.01
No problems where found

Since the November 27, 2020 release, the recommended settings have been working reliably for almost all devices.
The recommended settings can be found here:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5/permalink/4603084736431652

If you don't want to use facebook, you can ask in the Gitter room.

I would like to close this issue.
Please let me know if there are any reasons not to.
I am no longer experiencing this issue. From my standpoint, it can be closed.

Looks like this case has already been reopened. Just as a feedback to you: I had this problem once again with the latest xDrip nightly. After reading this ticket I switched back to the above November Build. After that I was able to connect just fine from my Redmi 7a to the Dexcom G6 Sensor.

So looks to me we have a regression here?
There are no reports of this issue any longer as long as you use an xDrip release of November 27, 2020 or after, and as long as your xDrip settings are correct.
